limits: Root basket presence does not establish a current root seat.
Subnet rankings exclude child-only hotkeys and parents without their own direct permit; they are not an exhaustive ranking of every staking option.
Provider nominator APY is used without a second take deduction; this audit does not independently reconstruct every historical reward payment.
Registration age is global hotkey age, not proof of operation on one subnet throughout the yield window.
Window-average agreement is not a volatility measure. Participation is not uptime.
Unknown identities stay addresses. Identity labels do not verify insurance, security or service quality.
Root staker returns and capital returns are period returns, not APY or personalized profit. The spot-to-quote gap is a whole-fund valuation comparison, not an individual redemption fee.
No account connection, staking, trade or claim transaction is performed by these research pages.
